_comment: Cross-language vectors for TfEpisodicMemory. Recall scores episodes by term-overlap: score = sum over shared terms (len>=2, case-insensitive, split on non-alphanumeric) of q_tf * d_tf. Ordered desc, take N. Episodes indexed on Title + ' ' + ContentJson. NOTE: results with EQUAL scores have implementation-defined relative order (map iteration), so 'expectedIds' is asserted as a SET unless 'ordered' is true (used only when the top scores are strictly distinct).
